trends.headline: Yellow line crawling through the Tube
trends.snippet: Twenty-two minutes at Embarcadero and counting. People are walking Market instead.

trends.headline: Announcements say Richmond, signs say Daly City
trends.snippet: Train identity crisis at Montgomery. Half the car got off. Half should have.

trends.headline: Fare gates rejecting cards at Powell
trends.snippet: Tap, red X, try the next gate. Everyone is doing the same dance.

trends.headline: Powell Street elevator out again
trends.snippet: Stairs are a contact sport. Strollers and bikes stacking at the landing.

trends.headline: Millbrae cutoff is a sprint tonight
trends.snippet: If you miss this one you are on a bus and a prayer. Platform is already anxious.

trends.headline: MacArthur bottleneck on the hour
trends.snippet: Three lines, one platform, two announcements that disagree. Classic transfer.

trends.headline: Scooters in the bike car, bikes in the aisle
trends.snippet: The first car is a storage unit. Bring patience, not a frame.

trends.headline: Civic Center packed, next train 12 min
trends.snippet: Doors cycling, nobody moving. The following train is not empty either.

seedNote: sample — not mixed into the live feed

seed.name: Pittsburg Bay
seed.text: Boarded at MacArthur thinking Millbrae. Doors closed. Richmond. The map on the car still said yellow. I am in El Cerrito energy and I have a meeting at Montgomery.

snippet.text: This is a weekly sport. Look at the destination before you sit.

seed.name: Dublin Wait
seed.text: Dublin/Pleasanton showing 22 minutes. Platform is a parking lot of people checking the app that is also lying. If you are still at West Dublin, stay on the bus.

seed.name: Tube Rider
seed.text: Transbay Tube, no bars, AC doing a rumor. We have been between West Oakland and Embarcadero long enough to learn the emergency sticker by heart.

snippet.text: Same train. I counted the lights.

seed.name: Powell Up
seed.text: Powell St elevator out. Again. Two flights of stairs with a suitcase and a stroller traffic jam. This is not a surprise. It is a lifestyle.

seed.name: Gate Jam
seed.text: Montgomery fare gate ate my Clipper, flashed red, then jammed open for everyone behind me. Agent booth empty. Honor system with extra steps.

seed.name: Bike Car West
seed.text: Bike car on the Dublin train was a wall of handlebars. I skipped two trains. If you bring a cargo bike at 5:15 you are the delay.

snippet.text: Saw you on the platform. The next one was worse.

seed.name: Platform Heat
seed.text: Concord platform in August is a griddle. No shade, no breeze, the arriving train is also warm. Warm-platform summer is undefeated.

seed.name: Millbrae Mix
seed.text: Richmond vs Millbrae is not a mixup, it is a trap. Same platform, opposite lives. I now photograph the headsign like a crime scene.

snippet.text: I did this today. We are a support group.

seed.name: Antioch End
seed.text: Yellow line crawled from Pittsburg Center like it owed the rails money. Four stops. Twenty-eight minutes. I could have walked the highway faster and I would not have.

seed.name: 19th Wait
seed.text: 19th St Oakland is shoulder-to-shoulder and the next Richmond is “arriving” for the third time. If you hear the tones, do not celebrate yet.

seed.name: Colma Skip
seed.text: Train skipped Colma without a word. Platform full of people who had already tagged in. Someone yelled at the operator through a closed door. Fair.

seed.name: SFO Air
seed.text: SFO station is not the terminal. It is a walk, an elevator lottery, and a family arguing with a fare machine. Budget forty minutes or miss the flight.

seed.name: Warm Springs
seed.text: Green line to Warm Springs saying 18 min, then 12, then 18 again. Berryessa people are sitting on the floor like this is a delayed flight.

seed.name: Civic Gate
seed.text: Civic Center fare gates are eating Clipper cards and coughing them back. I tapped three times. The fourth was a jump. Not proud. Not sorry.

snippet.text: Montgomery did the same thing an hour ago.

seed.name: Lake Merritt Up
seed.text: Lake Merritt elevator smells like a science project and one of the two is out. Stairs it is. My knees have opinions.

seed.name: West Oak Jump
seed.text: West Oakland transfer is a stampede if the Dublin train and the Tube train hit at once. I lost a shoe. I found the shoe. I missed the train.

seed.name: Berryessa Clock
seed.text: Berryessa platform clock is seven minutes fast or the train is seven minutes slow. Either way I am lying to my calendar.

seed.name: Embarc Delay
seed.text: Embarcadero bottleneck. Three lines, one platform mood. Someone is eating chips like we are not in a metal tube under Market.

snippet.text: That was me. Salt and vinegar. No regrets.

seed.name: Fremont Car
seed.text: Fremont train with no AC and every window locked. Warm-platform summer followed us into the car. I am a melted Clipper card.

seed.name: North Berk Lift
seed.text: North Berkeley elevator out since Tuesday if the handwritten sign is telling the truth. The other sign says “temporarily.” It is Friday.

seed.name: MacArthur Mix
seed.text: MacArthur is where the colors lie. I watched six people board Richmond with Millbrae faces. I said something. They did not get off. See you in El Cerrito.

seed.name: Daly City End
seed.text: Daly City turnback. Train sat with doors open for twelve minutes while the operator argued with the radio. At least we were above ground.
